title: Suunto App Workout Ascent Leaderboard
dataSources: Strava API activities (`strava:activity`), Garmin Connect (`garmin:activity`), Fitbit Web API (`fitbit:activity`), Peloton workout history (`peloton:workout`), Zwift/TrainingPeaks exports.
app: Strava / Garmin Connect / Fitbit / Peloton / Zwift APIs and webhooks via Splunk HEC scripted inputs; GPX/FIT/CSV activity exports ingested as files.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=suunto:workout ascent_m=*
| stats sum(ascent_m) as total_value, avg(ascent_m) as avg_value by activity_type
| sort - total_value
description: Ranks activity type values by total and average ascent across Suunto workout events.
value: Leaderboards help you see which people, devices, places, or projects dominate the signal.
implementation: Ingest numeric `ascent_m` values for each Suunto workout event and review total and average ascent by activity type.
visualization: Table of entities ranked by total ascent.
grandmaExplanation: It compares your which activity type shows the biggest ascent numbers in your Suunto workout data.
